label: D2 after an a2 stay that follows a newly rewarded a2 trial (early episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when this trial's choice was a2 (in_action=2) and the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward=1), with the previous choice also a2 (a stay, or unknown at window start), and essentially only in the first ~50 trials of an episode (none after trial 59). Within that, it is strongest when the reward is the first after an unrewarded trial (the trial two back was unrewarded): long runs of consecutive rewards are mostly silent, so it behaves like a 'freshly rewarded a2 stay' signal that decays. Top activations land on rare S1 transitions after an a2 choice that was rewarded on the previous trial; reached S2 also fires. It never fires at D1/GO, after a1 choices, after unrewarded trials or switches. Predicate (all observed variables) gives dev P=0.32 R=0.74 F1=0.44 and mass recall 0.91. Requiring the trial two back to be unrewarded (==0) raises precision to 0.44 but lowers mass recall to 0.68. The ep_trial<50 condition is a within-episode time correlate, likely a drifting slow hidden state; without it precision drops to 0.15. Many predicate-true steps stay silent, so precision is incomplete.
